channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.6.7
- Rebuilds the unified Workbench around one compact left navigation and removes duplicated sidebars and redundant top-level controls. - Removes empty tab rails and oversized vertical gaps so every workflow starts at the top of its workspace. - Restores compact, content-sized buttons throughout Home, Dictation, Support, Checkup, and Personalization. - Preserves the approved dark Templeton Slate palette, Studio Hardware cards, model controls, Voice Studio artwork, and Kiki graphics. - Gives Meetings, Voice Studio, Audio File, and Dictionary enough embedded space to keep their headings, instructions, and controls visible. - Expands Personalization tables and form fields, keeps Guided Review aligned, and supports selecting and updating saved snippets. - Adds keyboard focus treatment that matches Kiki's sage palette and verifies Command-A in editable text areas. - Adds release diagnostics that reject duplicated legacy navigation and empty single-page tab strips.

# Kiki 0.6.6
- Makes Kiki a dark-only Studio Hardware app across the Workbench, title and context chrome, settings, controls, popovers, and listening display. - Removes the Light and Follow System appearance choices from Settings. - Prevents layer-backed Workbench chrome from caching light palette colors before it joins the dark window hierarchy. - Keeps the approved Templeton Slate palette, Studio Hardware graphics, layout, and workflows unchanged. - Adds release diagnostics that reject a non-dark application or Workbench window.

# Kiki 0.6.5
- Replaces Kiki's collection of separate primary windows with the unified Guided Workbench: Home, Dictation, Meetings, Voice Studio, Library, Personalization, Models, and Settings now live in one consistent workspace. - Preserves the established Templeton Slate and Studio Hardware visuals while adding descriptive left-side navigation and state-aware workflow pages. - Routes existing menu commands and quick actions into the correct Workbench section without removing the underlying local features. - Uses a compact, resizable window that stays well within the display instead of expanding to the full screen width. - Prevents high-resolution artwork and embedded legacy screens from forcing the Workbench wider or causing recursive AppKit layout failures. - Adds diagnostics for Workbench routing, native click handling, and compact layout behavior.

# Kiki 0.6.4
- Removes cross-track Zoom echo before Meeting Intelligence builds the transcript, preventing the same speech from appearing under both the microphone and remote speaker. - Replaces keyword-only action blurbs with contextual action items that include the responsible participant and source timestamp. - Joins short commitments to the nearby explanation that completes them, while rejecting questions and incomplete sentence fragments. - Recognizes direct requests such as "Could you send that?", assigns them to the other participant, and records who requested them. - Adds regressions based on the first live Zoom meeting, including duplicate speech, fragment rejection, contextual commitments, request ownership, and export formatting.
